changes.title: Sail in bed
items: Sailing to an island always ends with her waking up in bed there: the alarm, last night's clothes in a pile, and getting dressed before the door opens, as every morning

changes.title: Sail transition
items: Sailing from the sea chart: the next island is made while the chart flies you in, so there's no long frozen picture before the dive
The chart's zoom slows to wait for the island when it needs to, then flows straight into the dive
The dive now starts further out to sea and comes in across the water
The island's trees arrive under the loading mist, the ones the dive passes over first
The sea is drawn under the dive as it comes in across the water
Before landing in her bedroom, the dive comes round to see the whole treehouse oak, crown and all
The island's ground along the dive is drawn before it starts, so it no longer shows black through the descent

changes.title: Oak treehouse
items: The treehouse is a great old oak now, north-west of the dancefloor: six rooms up its trunk, from the Dining Room to the Turret, and a pair of rooms off each of the lower four
Its floor is one shape of the tree's own wood: walk from your bed down the trunk to the Terrace and step off its open south-east rim to fly
No more curtains to wait for in the morning: the bedroom door opens as soon as you're dressed
The cloak pegs hang in the Cloakroom now, by the hats
